name: Noon Quran Schools Manager
author: kouider bounama

sections.description:
Noon Quran Schools Manager is a translation-ready WordPress plugin for tahfez centers.

  • Students, parents, and teachers
  • Daily attendance and recitation tracking
  • Memorization plans, golden record (khatm/ijazah), and student files
  • Exams, reports, and statistics
  • Fees, payments, salaries, income and expenses
  • Motivation points and printable certificates
  • Parent, student, and teacher portals (shortcodes)
  • CSV export, CSV import, and JSON backup/restore

English is the source language: every interface string goes through gettext (Text Domain: noon-quran-schools-manager, Domain Path: /languages), so the plugin follows the site locale automatically, including right-to-left locales.

Database values are stored as locale-independent keys (numeric surah numbers, status keys such as excellent or present), while the interface always shows translated labels. Existing Arabic installs are upgraded automatically on activation/update.

The admin interface uses the center name and logo from Settings, and supports the Cairo font for right-to-left locales.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin (tables and data migrations run automatically)
  3. Open the Quran Schools menu and complete Settings
sections.faq:
Which locales are supported?

Any locale with a translation installed. English is the fallback source language.

Will activating the plugin change my existing data?

No. Recitations that stored surah names, and localized grade/relation/specialization values, are converted to canonical keys automatically. The demo backup in assets/qsm-demo-backup.json uses the same canonical values.

Does it need the intl PHP extension?

No. It is used for accurate Umm al-Qura Hijri dates when available; without it the plugin falls back to an approximate tabular Hijri calendar.
sections.changelog:
1.0.4

  • English-first, translation-ready interface with automatic LTR/RTL support
  • Canonical stored values: numeric surahs, grade/attendance/plan/status keys
  • Automatic migration of localized values (surah names, relations, specializations, grades)
  • Shared label helpers, translated JavaScript via wp.i18n, and a Cairo font for RTL locales
  • Umm al-Qura Hijri dates via the intl extension, with a tabular fallback
  • CSV export includes readable surah names alongside the numeric columns
  • Converted every screen (golden record, points, certificates, import included) to gettext strings
  • Fixed legacy wp_qsm_* table prefixes when restoring a JSON backup
  • Teacher account creation now uses the shared WordPress account helper
  • Uninstall removes every plugin table, option, migration flag, and role
  • Removed the duplicate parent portal bootstrap call

1.0.3

  • Only a site administrator can create WordPress accounts or assign the supervisor role
  • Remove activation error_log and prefix uninstall globals
  • Cast and escape database IDs and option values before output
  • Text domain matches the plugin slug: noon-quran-schools-manager
  • Prefixes, options, roles, shortcodes, and tables use noonqsm (4+ characters)
  • Removed the legacy qsm_ migration and old shortcodes
  • Escaped admin and portal output
  • Sidebar stays usable on short desktop screens without a visible scrollbar

1.0.2

  • Enqueue print/card/certificate CSS, sanitize export/backup nonces, escape card initial, remove load_plugin_textdomain, lower admin menu position

1.0.1

  • Distinct Plugin URI (repository) and Author URI (profile)

1.0.0

  • First public release for WordPress.org
  • Author: Kouider Bounama (https://github.com/kouiderbounama)
